about: Every update of the simulator, newest first. The first entry is the version the app shows everywhere. Tags come from the list below. 1-8 short lines per update, plain words.

updates.title: Survivors, Spell Cards and Music
notes: Dark World Survivors grows: 9 leaders, new weapons, Seam's shop, DARKNESS tiers and maps built from the game's rooms.
Spell Card Rush is now RUSH I and II: Gerson, Titan, Aqua, Pink and Flowery, new partners and Swatch's café.
The Sound Test is now a music player: every soundtrack, voice and sound, with a scene for each chapter.
PROCEED: Chapter 5's weird route at the lake, played out on the shore.
UNDERTALE's naming screen on the POWER page: your name replaces CHARA in UNDERTALE fights.
The Android app is out: get it on the Download page.
Faster menus and fights, much less memory, and music now plays on Safari and iPhone.
Lots of bug fixes.

updates.title: Console borders
notes: The console versions' borders around the game: CONFIG > DISPLAY > Border.
Every chapter gets its own: Castle Town, Cyber City, TV World, the Sanctuary, Titan, the Garden, Flower Castle and more.
UNDERTALE fights get Ruins, Snowdin, Waterfall, Hotland, Castle and True Lab.
ANIMATED crossfades between areas and moves like on console (watch Titan's eyes). STATIC holds still.
Menu border follows the chapter you browse, or pick a favourite, including Beauty, Sepia and Casino.

updates.title: Party update
notes: Flowery can join your party, with his own spells and team ACTs.
Parties of up to 50, with a rebuilt POWER screen to set them up.
Freeze any enemy with IceShock or SnowGrave, and SnowGrave works at 100% TP.
UNDERTALE 10th Anniversary fights: Sans and Mr. Sunshine & Abberant.
A Castle Town tour you can walk around, and new menu pages for every mode.
A Test Dummy with 500,000 HP for trying out teams.
Faster loading on phones and smoother fights everywhere.
Lots of bug fixes.

updates.title: Bug Fixes
notes: Bug fixes.

updates.title: Terminal install fixes
notes: The PowerShell install command on the download page works now (it stopped at the checksum).
The download page lists the PowerShell command first, with no prompt symbols to copy by accident.
The terminal box on the download page is cleaner and easier to read.

updates.title: Launcher, sprites and rewind fixes
notes: Desktop app: updating to the newest version no longer stops with an HTTP 404.
Chapter 4 and 5 sprites no longer come out scrambled for some players right after an update.
A tab left open across an update keeps working: video export and other features no longer fail with an HTTP 404.
Rewinding brings the music back the way it was, even after a game over, and no longer stacks looping sounds like the orange soul charge.
The Roaring Knight split box no longer disappears when you rewind after dying, and Spamton's warped box lost its diagonal line.
A DOWNLOAD button on the fight list for the desktop app.
Phones: the DISCORD / X / BETA links sit beside the game instead of over the party HP row.
Links to the site on Discord and X show the current preview image.

updates.title: The desktop app and new pages
notes: The desktop app 1.1.0 for Windows: plays offline, updates itself and opens straight into the game. Get it at deltarunesim.com/download.
New pages for downloads, fights, schools and about, in the game's own font. Some characters there react when you click them.
Phones: a C button in every fight. Item editor: pick a quantity (x1, x2, x4 or fill).
A tab left open now reloads itself after an update, on the fight list and never in the middle of a fight.
Fewer background requests, so the stats and the bot stay up on busy days.

updates.title: Sprite hotfix
notes: Fixed sprites drawing garbled in every fight after the last update.
Everything from the big bug report update is still in: the Hammer of Justice lag fix, custom party and phone fixes.
If fights still look wrong, reload the page with Ctrl+Shift+R.

updates.title: The big bug report update
notes: Hammer of Justice no longer lags after the shell attack. Pink and Flowery run lighter, and chapter 5 music skips less.
Kris's ACT works from any party slot, and Tenna's board balls work with custom parties.
Jackenstein, Titan, Sound of Justice, Pink, Flowery, Seth & Aqua, Blue & Yellow and more chapter 4 and 5 fixes.
Spamton NEO's heart and final attack, Muffet's box, Asriel's sounds, Omega Flowey's fire hitboxes and Rudinn's Glowshard.
Tenna board 1 no longer softlocks and its battles have music. Tenna's minigames have their backgrounds again.
Phones: C button in every fight, a joystick on the boards, and equip and stats editing work on touch.
Item editor: pick a quantity (x1, x2, x4 or fill). Ctrl+/Ctrl- no longer changes game speed.
The soul no longer drifts after rewind or retry, and GIVE UP clears the game over like the original.

updates.title: Lag fixes and quick links
notes: Tenna's All-Star Cast no longer slows the game down. The spotlight is drawn on the GPU now.
The DARK modifier no longer lags.
GIGA Queen's music no longer plays over itself.
Gerson no longer vanishes during Rude Buster, and his turtle shell attack doesn't drop the frame rate anymore.
New buttons under the party stats: Discord, X, TikTok, Beta and About.
New About this project card, with a link to Known limits.

updates.title: Big bug fix update
notes: Boss fights run lighter, sounds can't stack into crackle, and CONFIG > Performance (Auto/Full/Light) helps weak PCs.
Gerson's arena no longer blacks out between turns. Berdly's sky, K.Round's map and Jevil's target flash are lined up.
Chapter 1: Ralsei's ACTs use his turn, Warning works on Susie, and portraits sit in the text box again.
Queen, Spamton, Spamton NEO, Sweet Cap'n Cakes, Berdly 2 and GIGA Queen fixes. F1 heals in Spamton's fights.
Dojo fights are grouped and fought in the dojo, with the Clover Rematch timer.
Chapter 3: Shuttah's photos, Rouxls's ACT grid, the Annoying Dog card, Zapper's lasers, and the Knight takes real damage.
Hammer of Justice: Gerson hits Rude Buster back. Rhythm game songs start in sync.
Custom parties no longer freeze against Rouxls and the Knight. Dialogue shows names instead of {0} and {1}.

updates.title: iPhone loading and smoother Knight
notes: Fixed iPhones and older Safari getting stuck at half on the loading bar.
Browsers too old to run the sim now show an "update your browser" note instead of a stuck bar.
The Roaring Knight runs much smoother. The final attack went from about 4 fps to full speed.
UNDERTALE fights have their own stat editor (LV, HP, AT, DF, weapon, armor) and their own 8-slot item bag.
Custom encounters: every enemy attacks each turn now. Set "Attackers per turn" in the editor to limit it.
Updated the known limits in ABOUT.

updates.title: Flowery's climb fixed
notes: Flowery's climbing part doesn't lag anymore.
Long play sessions lag less. A drawing cache used to slow every fight down over time.
Autoplay can do the climb now. Before, it got stuck and also blocked your arrow keys.
The boost flowers work across their whole row, like in the game, instead of hurting you.
When you climb yourself, it runs at the Minigame speed from CONFIG.

updates.title: More bosses in the BOSS tab
notes: The BOSS tab now has the bosses from chapters 3, 4 and 5 and UNDERTALE.
The BOSS tab lists more bosses.
Sans, Asgore, Asriel, Undyne, Mettaton and the rest are under BOSS now too.

updates.title: Softer loading errors
notes: Fixed a script error some players got while the page was loading.
The loading error waits 20 seconds now, and closes by itself once the game starts.
The loading error has a CONTINUE button.
If a sprite sheet, a sound or a font doesn't load, the game keeps going and tries again in the background.
New UPDATES page with the notes for every update. It's at the top of the fight list.
Every update gets a real version number from now on.

updates.title: Boss fixes and loading
notes: Lanino & Elnina no longer get stuck at the end of the chapter 4 fight.
Photoshop Flowey's left side shows up again.
Autoplay can finish Photoshop Flowey, Asgore, Asriel, Sans, Mettaton, the Amalgamates and the Lost Souls.
UNDERTALE and chapter 4-5 fights load when you pick them, so the first visit downloads less.
Files that fail to load are tried again. If one still won't load, you get a RETRY button.
New network check page for school and work networks: deltarunesim.com/check
Pressing Z on the title goes to the fight list again, not straight into JEVIL.
The game clip next to the menu no longer shows blackjack.

updates.title: Faster first visit
notes: The title screen shows up a lot sooner. It only waits for one small sprite sheet now, the rest loads behind it.
Chapter 4 and 5 sprites load after the title is up.
A first visit goes from the title straight into a fight.
The first-time intro doesn't play before your first fight anymore. It's still in CONFIG.
The BETA card and the tutorial offer wait until after your first fight.
Your first fight shows the Z, X and arrow keys.
On a phone, the turn-your-phone card doesn't block your first visit.

updates.title: Fight stats
notes: New fight stats page: deltarunesim.com/stats
It shows how many fights get played, the win rates, the hardest fights and the hits taken.
Pick the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or all time.
Fights send their result with no name, no account and no cookie.
A run that changes your game speed now tells you.

updates.title: Launch
notes: The simulator has its own home now: deltarunesim.com
Over 300 fights from every DELTARUNE chapter, plus UNDERTALE.
Boss rush, gauntlet and a daily fight.
Autoplay, replays, rewind and practice tools.
Bonus games: Dark World Survivors, Spell Card Rush, blackjack, MANIA, Tetris and DARKDLE.
Touch controls for phones.
A Discord for bug reports and ideas.
